_readme: This file is the whole catalogue. Edit it here and nothing else — Vercel rebuilds
every page automatically when you commit.
price       whole rupees, no commas, no 'PKR'. 3000 not '3,000'.
available   false shows the piece as sold out and disables Add to cart.
colourways  [] means no picker is shown. Otherwise the customer must choose one.
images      first one is the main photo and the social-share image.
category    bags | charms | flowers  (drives the /shop filter)
ITEMS MARKED "REVIEW": I guessed these colourways from your photos because the
repo does not record what yarn you stock. Correct them before launch or customers
will order colours you do not have.

contact._emailNote: CHECK THIS. Three spellings have been in play: the brand is knotsocutepk, the site said notsocutepk@gmail.com, and this is nosocutepk@gmail.com. Every receipt and order alert goes here. Send yourself a test email to confirm.
contact._courierNote: Replace with TCS / Leopards / M&P / PostEx etc. once decided. Appears on the confirmation page and the policies page.

delivery._note: mode 'quoted' = charge nothing for delivery at checkout; the customer is told it is confirmed on WhatsApp before dispatch. Correct while rates depend on distance, and it works with COD because the courier collects the cash anyway. Switch mode to 'flat' once you have fixed rates, and set the two figures below.

products.name: sweetheart bow
products.blurb: A fat little bow with a lobster clasp — the one that sells out first.
products.description: A generous double-loop bow, worked tight so it holds its shape, finished with a lobster clasp that clips to a bag strap or a belt loop. It is the piece people ask about most, and the first one gone every drop.

images.alt: Sweetheart bow crochet keychain in pale pink yarn with a lobster clasp

products.name: butter puff
products.blurb: Croissant, or a cinnamon roll if the yarn allows. Stuffed soft.
products.description: A little pastry, stuffed soft enough to squish. Comes as a croissant or a cinnamon roll depending on which yarn is on the table that week — tell us which you would rather have in the order notes.

images.alt: Butter puff crochet croissant keychain in golden yarn

products.name: lip locket
products.blurb: Clips inside a bag so the one thing you always lose stays put.
products.description: A snug sleeve for one lipstick or a lip oil, with a clip that fastens to the inside of a bag. Worked dense so the tube does not slip out when the bag goes upside down.

images.alt: Lip locket crochet lipstick holder that clips inside a bag

products.name: cloud tote
products.blurb: The staple. Roomy enough for a book, dense enough to hold shape.
products.description: The one to own if you only own one. Big enough for a paperback, a water bottle and the usual mess, worked at a tight gauge so it stands up on its own instead of slumping. Doubled handles so the weight does not dig in.

images.alt: Cloud tote crochet bag, front view
Cloud tote crochet bag, held by the handles
Cloud tote crochet bag, detail of the stitch

products.name: forever bloom
products.blurb: Rose, sunflower, lavender, tulip — wrapped and ribboned. They never wilt.
products.description: A single stem, wrapped in paper and tied with a ribbon, ready to hand over. Pick the bloom you want below. They do not drink, they do not drop petals, and they outlast whatever occasion you bought them for.

images.alt: Crochet lavender stems wrapped and ribboned

products.name: cobweb wrap
products.blurb: Ties over the hip on low-rise denim. Open web, deep red, one size.
products.description: An open spiderweb triangle that ties over the hip on low-rise denim, or over the head like a bandana. One size, long ties, deliberately loose gauge so it drapes instead of sitting stiff.

images.alt: Cobweb wrap crochet spiderweb bandana in deep red

products.name: toast keeper
products.blurb: A slice of bread that eats your charger cable instead of losing it.
products.description: A slice of bread with a slit down the middle. Wind the charger cable, tuck it in, and it stops being a knot at the bottom of your bag. Also works for earphones.

images.alt: Toast keeper crochet bread slice cable holder

products.name: tissue tuck
products.blurb: Holds a travel pack of tissues, clips to a bag, has little legs.
products.description: Sized to a standard travel pack of tissues, with a clip for a bag strap and two small legs that serve no purpose whatsoever. Refill it by sliding the pack in from the back.

images.alt: Tissue tuck crochet pouch with little legs

products.name: ichigo mini
products.blurb: A strawberry on a long crochet strap — seeded in cream, leafed in mint.
products.description: A strawberry the size of a fist, seeded in cream and leafed in mint, hanging from a long crochet strap that sits at the hip. Fits a phone, a card and a lip oil, and nothing else — which is the point.

images.alt: Ichigo mini crochet strawberry bag on a long strap
Ichigo mini crochet strawberry bag, side view
Ichigo mini crochet strawberry bag, worn over the shoulder
